## Spookling (CR 1/4)

As you examine the intricately designed padlock on the chest, you notice a slight shimmer. Suddenly, the “padlock” unfurls into a tiny, six-legged creature with glinting black eyes. It lets out a soft chirp before scurrying away with surprising speed.  

**XP** 100  
N Diminutive aberration (shapechanger)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 30 ft.; Perception +5  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 17, flat-footed 14 (+3 Dex, +4 size)  
**hp** 9 (1d8+1)  
**Fort** +1, **Ref** +3, **Will** +2  


**Offense**


**Speed** 15 ft., climb 15 ft.  
**Melee** bite +5 (1d2-4), tongue +5 (special)  
**Space** 1 ft.; **Reach** 0 ft.  
**Special Attacks** sticky tongue (Diminutive or smaller only)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 1, **Dex** 17, **Con** 12, **Int** 6, **Wis** 11, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +0; **CMB** -5, **CMD** 5 (13 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Weapon Finesse  
**Skills** Climb +11, Perception +5, Stealth +19  
**Languages** understands Undercommon and Silent Speech (Xeniomorph)  


**Special Abilities**


**Mimic Accessory (Ex)** As a standard action, a Spookling can assume the shape of any Diminutive or Fine object that could serve as an accessory (such as a padlock, brooch, or small ornament). This grants it a +20 racial bonus on Disguise checks to appear as that object. A Spookling using this ability can maintain its shape indefinitely and can revert to its natural form as a free action.  

**Sticky Tongue (Ex)** A Spookling can make a melee touch attack with its sticky tongue. On a hit against a Diminutive or smaller creature, the target is affected as though by a tanglefoot bag (Reflex DC 11 negates). The Spookling can only affect one target at a time with its tongue. The effect lasts for 2d4 rounds or until the Spookling releases the target (a free action). The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Six-Legged Stability** Spooklings gain a +8 racial bonus to their CMD against trip attempts due to their six- legged stance.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any (usually with Xeniomorphs)  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or cluster (3–12)  
**Treasure** none
